name: gui_build_full
description: GB-2, the build part: one project from File > New Project > Blank, with Studio's GUI only, holding everything GB-1 built in five (gui_build_A..E). Stage 1: the Graph tab's palette adds a render.material_pass of deferred_geometry_v1 (its draw loop comes along), Add Object > Cube and > Floor, the KeyLight at intensity 6 in the Inspector, Add fullscreen pass with Uses scene lights. Stage 2: Features > shadow_directional (RS-10), then the lighting pass's New... > Deferred lighting > Create (UX-5b: the G-buffer lines and shadow_map in one edit); its colour onto present's + input shows the lit box (not the gradient) and the box's shadow on the floor. Stage 3: the palette's render.compute row offers engine://rt_shadow_mask_pipeline (UX-5d), whose world_position and normal read the material pass by name. The lighting template has no place for a mask, so the author edits shaders/deferred_lighting.frag in their own editor (two spans: binding 6 declared, the key light's shadow taken from it); the Frame Plan tab has to be in front for Studio to send reload_shaders, and the Graph tab shows binding 6 only after its Refresh. The mask dropped on binding 6: the floor beside the box is now in the mask's hard shadow, not the shadow map's soft one. Stage 4: the lit image's Format set to R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT (Add fullscreen pass makes R8G8B8A8_UNORM, which clips the light at 1); a bright pass (engine://bloom_highpass from the Fragment list), Add loop with a body pass, Count 4, the carry, the body image's size by f > Half each element, a composite (engine://bloom_composite) reading the lit colour and the loop's output, its image float too; present takes the composite and the dark just above the floor's edges is lit by the bloom. Stage 5: a tone map pass, New... > Tone map > Create; present takes it and the floor the light made white has a tone again. The plan is checked at the end: trace before lighting, lighting reading the shadow map and the mask, four copies with the carry, composite, tone map, present. Stops on the way: the name field of the second New... keeps the first one's name (deferred_lighting), so tone_map is typed; the Graph's pass fields switch off for a moment after every edit (UX-5d reads the shader list), so each gesture on them waits for them to settle. Typed: the project folder and the name gb_full, material_pass and render.compute in the palette's filter, 6 in the light's intensity, 4 in Count, tone_map in the template name, and the two spans of the lighting shader.
